title: campanula macrorhiza f. nicaeensis
intro: Campanula macrorhiza f. nicaeensis, commonly known as tall bellflower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. Traditionally used in herbal medicine, this plant has been employed for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, coughs, and bronchitis, as well as its ability to act as a natural expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Campanula macrorhiza f. nicaeensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and spasmolytic properties, which help to relax muscles and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified in various studies on the plant's composition.
